events.headline: INTERNATIONAL LNG PRICES RISE AMID STRAIT OF HORMUZ CLOSURE
events.detail: Prices for natural gas in Europe and Asia have diverged from those in the United States since the February 28 closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: THE 10TH U.S. LIQUEFIED NATURAL GAS EXPORT TERMINAL, GOLDEN PASS, SHIPS FIRST CA
